subject: Clarify MAP: data retention carveouts, DPA clauses & SOC 2 evidence flow
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finovate.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finovate Legal <legal@finovate.co>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: clarifying evidence & retention for close timeline

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited. Before we move toward a signed MPA I need to confirm a few security/compliance items that are blockers for procurement and legal:

- SOC 2: we need a recent Type II report and confirmation of the scope (does it cover hosted API and any dedicated/private on-prem installs?).
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have an inventory or completed CAIQ for the current catalog we plan to use? A gap matrix would be ideal.
- DPA: Finovate has a standard DPA; legal flagged two clauses for retention and subprocessors. We anticipate requiring a 7-year retention carveout for certain transaction logs in the US.
- Data residency: we'll need to confirm EU residency guarantees for EU customer data and whether Redwood supports EU-only storage in Private deployments.

Can you map these items into the MAP with owners and target dates? Our procurement deadline is 2027-01-14 and legal wants any redlines returned by EOD 2026-12-30.

Thanks,
Alyssa

--
Alyssa Chen

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. I've sketched an initial MAP slice below and attached our latest SOC2 Type II (Q2 2026) for your review. Kimberly and Naomi are looped for DPA & CAIQ items.

High-level MAP entries (owners & target):
- SOC 2 evidence (Logan) — deliver SOC2-Type2-Report-Q2-2026.pdf and controls inventory by 2026-12-29.
- CAIQ & gap matrix (Naomi) — provide completed CAIQ and a short gap summary by 2026-12-30.
- DPA redline (Kimberly) — review Finovate DPA and return redline + commentary by 2026-12-30.
- Retention carveout request (Legal/Finovate) — we'll propose language for limited retention exceptions; target proposal 2026-12-31.
- Data residency confirmation (Logan/Infra) — confirm EU-only storage options and export controls by 2027-01-04.

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-Report-Q2-2026.pdf (attached, stub).

Next steps: Kimberly — can you take the lead on the DPA redline? Naomi — can you confirm which models in the catalog have completed CAIQs vs in-flight? Alyssa — I'll add these milestones to a mutual action plan doc and share a HubSpot link after we get the redline back.

If we meet these targets we're aligned with Finovate's procurement window.

Best,
Logan

> On Mon, 28 Dec 2026 at 10:03 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. I've sketched an initial MAP slice below and attached our latest SOC2 Type II (Q2 2026) for your review.
> 
Hi all — quick update from legal. I've finished an initial pass on Finovate's DPA. Main points:

- Subprocessor list: we'll provide the current subprocessor registry; we propose a 30-day notice window for changes (instead of consent for each change).
- Retention carveout: Redwood cannot agree to a blanket 7-year retention for all transaction logs. We can offer a scoped exception for anonymized audit hashes or escrowed summaries, or an alternate path: encrypted escrow with key-escrow conditions (we've seen that approved before).
- EU residency: we confirm EU-region hosting for hosted API (selected models) and Private deployments can be configured to keep data in-customer VPCs; we need to capture the topology and runbook.

I've attached the redline (DPA-redline-finovate.docx — stub). Alyssa/legal: if you can point to the specific data classes that need 7-year retention we can propose precise language.

Proposed MAP updates (Kimberly notes):
- DPA redline delivery: 2026-12-30 (Kimberly) — attached.
- Retention proposal: 2026-12-31 (Legal + Logan) — propose escrow or scoped retention solution.
- CAIQ gap remediation plan: 2027-01-07 (Naomi) — list of in-flight items and mitigation timeline.

Logan — I'll attach the redline to the HubSpot record after Alyssa confirms.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Attachments: DPA-redline-finovate.docx (attachment stub)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finovate.co>

Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 16:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: clarifying evidence & retention for close timeline

Thanks Logan/Kimberly — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from legal after reviewing the redline:

- The 7-year ask is limited to transaction-level audit logs tied to signed contracts (not all payloads). Those logs must be accessible for e-discovery in the US.
- Escrow sounds promising — can Redwood propose the minimal schema we would escrow (e.g., time, contract-id hash, outcome code) so our legal team can validate?
- CAIQ gaps: for any control gaps that extend past 2027-01-07, legal prefers a contractual remediation commitment (milestone + SLA), not just a plan.

If Redwood can provide: (A) a short proposed escrow schema by 2026-12-31 and (B) a HubSpot MAP link that tracks owners/dates, we can move procurement to 'legal signoff' by 2027-01-06.

I'll expect the DPA redline in HubSpot and will route to our counsel on receipt.

Best,
Alyssa
